seo.webpageTitle: Starting at DYP, Part 2: The First Days — The Dev Notebook
seo.metaDescription: My first days at DYP: sitting alone on the front bench, meeting the friends who would later become my SIH team, a temporary hostel in Hinjewadi, joining GDGC, and building a game for a TechFest that never happened.

content.title: Starting at DYP, Part 2: The First Days
content.dek: Nervous benches, new friends, a hostel on the 11th floor, and building games for TechFest.
